Social Impact Assessment Report — Power Plant Project, Maharashtra_District_4, Maharashtra


Consultation process: 3 public consultation meetings were held at the Gram Panchayat office under the Gram Sabha / local body process required by the LARR Act, 2013. Approximately 66 persons attended across all sessions, against 91 families recorded as affected.

Objections at these sessions were raised principally by agricultural labourers.

Nature of objections — substantive: several families disputed the necessity of the alignment itself, arguing an alternative route would avoid settled habitation entirely.

Objection was recorded to the inclusion of a community burial ground within the boundary, which attendees said cannot be relocated on any terms.

Outcome: the Gram Sabha deferred its resolution, requesting a further sitting once written responses to the points above are furnished.

The consultation team notes that attendance represented a small share of the affected households, and that the sessions may not reflect the views of the wider affected population.

Objections at these sessions were raised principally by tenant cultivators.

Nature of objections — substantive: several families disputed the necessity of the alignment itself, arguing an alternative route would avoid settled habitation entirely.

Attendees repeatedly referred to an acquisition in a neighbouring district where compensation remains undisbursed after two years, and said they had no reason to expect different treatment here.

Speakers warned of an indefinite dharna at the site office if the process continues without a further hearing.

Outcome: the Gram Sabha deferred its resolution, requesting a further sitting once written responses to the points above are furnished.
